services.desc: Discover the wild beauty of the Grand Canyon’s Kaibab National Forest with Grand Canyon Trail Rides, previously Apache Stables, offering family-friendly horseback and wagon rides through stunning scenery, authentic western experiences, and unique evening adventures like campfire roasts and saloon rides. Book before the season ends on October 15, 2025, for unforgettable memories! There’s something magical about exploring the Grand Canyon area, specifically the Kaibab National Forest on horseback.
